body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> Alpine Electronics of America revealed its new dash-top solution for in-vehicle iPod playback 'ex-10' during CES 2008 Unveiled NY Press Preview. Consisting of 2.4-inch color TFT LCD display and remote control, it enables iPod music to be played back on the car speakers via FM transmitter or AUX input. The display can show phonebook list and missed/received/dialed calls, and the solution can also be used to control Bluetooth-enabled phone.
